test_title: PYST 186: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 24th Nov, 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six friends R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting in a straight line. T is third from the left and fourth from the right. V is between T and S. Also, S is to the immediate left of U. R is between T and W. Find the position of V from the right side.
solution:
Six friends R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting in a straight line.

1) T is third from the left and fourth from the right.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29ef8a1e0f226bbc280f63f4aba1a1efa7cd81594b125b390549b4f00314f630.png] 

2) V is between T and S and also, S is to the immediate left of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50fd15838428607bbe4180627258e4d6fe7cb50d258dd968366ae52bc676cfc1.png] 

3) R is between T and W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e284e4b074ba80acffce60fe6424a0799a79cbdd03c25e804fe777f091f49ee.png] 

∴ Here, 'V' is sitting 'third' from right side.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Third".**
